text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing we require an activation_quorum for any runtime config change that affects routing/quotas. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/internal/prs/512

jonah: +1 on safety. What's the exact rule? min responders or percent? Could be painful for small teams.

maria: Thinking: two fields — min_responders (int) + percent_agree (0-100). Default: min_responders=2, percent_agree=75. That means at least 2 regions/owners must ack and >=75% of sampled requests pass health checks during dry-run.

sahil: how do we sample/collect "agree"? Are we asking real traffic or team approvals?

maria: Good q. Plan: three signals: infra acks (owner approvals), canary telemetry (N min successful canary windows), and smoke-test approvals. All three must satisfy configured thresholds. We can opt to require only two of three for low-risk flags.

lee: console UX: need to show quorum status live, show which signals are missing, and allow emergency bypass with audit reason.

opsbot: automation note: when PR merges, bot will annotate rollout with activation_quorum metadata and block autoscale if quorum not met. (:robot_face:)

jonah: we also need a fallback for cross-region outages — if quorum can't be met due to partial region outage, we should allow time-limited override by SRE oncall.

maria: agreed. propose "override_token" with TTL and mandatory audit comment. Also log to audit-service/stream.

sahil: schema example:

```
{"flag_name":"route_priority_v2",
 "activation_quorum": {"min_responders":3, "percent_agree":80, "signals":["owner_ack","canary_pass","smoke_test"]},
 "override_policy": {"allow_override":true, "ttl_hours":2}
}
```

lee: Nice. Implementation questions: API changes to /config/apply? We'll need to add a preflight endpoint that returns quorum status without applying.

maria: yes — `POST /config/preflight` returns {quorum_status, missing_signals, sample_stats}.

jonah: Timeline? can we ship a soft opt-in for new flags first?

maria: Rollout plan: 1) preflight + console UX (opt-in via org policy), 2) require for new routing/quota flags, 3) backfill critical flags with analysis. Target: 4 weeks for preflight; 10 weeks for org-wide enforcement.

sahil: one more: telemetry cost — continuous sampling on all flags could be expensive. Need sampling window and aggregation at edge.

maria: yep — we'll sample at 1% by default and increase for flagged canaries. Also batch telemetry to reduce cardinality.

lee: I'll sketch console mockups and permission flows.

maria: thanks. I'll post PR link and an initial design doc. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll merge the preflight API stub.

opsbot: Reminder: Oncall SRE rota updated for override approvals: @sre-oncall team.
